content: In the United States, a Level III trauma center is a medical facility that provides emergency care to trauma patients who do not require the advanced services available at a Level I or Level II trauma center. These centers are mandated to have a specific number of surgeons available on-call 24 hours a day to address the needs of trauma patients. The designation of a hospital as a Level III trauma center is granted by the American College of Surgeons and is valid for a period of three years.
